facts.text: I am trying to get organized with my jewelry collection.
I want a list of all the jewelry pieces I need to take care of, including cleaning or resizing.
I started wearing my grandmother's pearl necklace daily as a comfort thing since my grandmother passed away.
My grandmother's pearl necklace needs to be cleaned and restrung again.
I have a silver necklace with a diamond pendant that I lost.
I am hoping to find the lost silver necklace with a diamond pendant.
I need to get my silver hoops cleaned.
I have been meaning to take my sister's opal ring back from my sister.
I need to get my gold bangle cleaned.
I have been wearing my gold bangle daily for two weeks.
My gold bangle has started to look a bit dull.
I have a pair of filigree earrings with tiny sapphires.
I recently started wearing my filigree earrings again after finding them in my jewelry box.
I am considering whether I should get my filigree earrings cleaned or inspected.
I will take my filigree earrings to a local jeweler who specializes in antique pieces.
I want a reminder of the details I should discuss with the jeweler when I take my earrings in.
